user.title: Add a Disney glow toy
user.description: Pick the ESPHome device running the disney_tx component. It broadcasts the toy's commands.

abort.already_configured: This transmitter is already set up.
abort.no_transmitter: No ESPHome device exposes an `advertise` action. Flash esphome/disney-tx.yaml and add it to Home Assistant first.

play_effect.name: Play effect
play_effect.description: Play an effect with up to five palette colours.

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: 1-4 palette colours (defaults to the colour slots that are on).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds before the toy stops by itself; 0 holds. Defaults to the Duration setting.

set_colors.name: Set colours
set_colors.description: Fill the colour slots that effects use, clockwise from the top: top + bottom, lower-left + upper-right, left + right, upper-left + lower-right. A running effect switches to them.

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: 1-4 palette colours; slots past the last one are switched off.

set_zones.name: Set zones
set_zones.description: Light each of the five LED zones in its own palette colour.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds before the toy stops by itself; 0 holds.

send_raw.name: Send raw packet
send_raw.description: Advertise raw command bytes (after the 83 01 company ID) for protocol experiments.
